artist.name: Sarah Barrios
artist.short_description: Sarah Barrios: an Afterglow editorial discovery candidate in pop.
artist.biography: Sarah Barrios is an American singer-songwriter associated with melodic pop and direct storytelling. Her catalogue includes “Have We Met Before,” a 2021 release with Eric Nam, and “Thank God You Introduced Me to Your Sister,” released later that year. Apple Music provides release-level confirmation for both songs, while Spotify and other catalogue listings document additional tracks such as “I H8 EVERY1,” “Make Me Your Villain,” and “Mourn The Living.” Her work is useful to Afterglow because it bridges softer singer-songwriter writing and brighter, hook-driven pop. She can be recommended alongside Chelsea Cutler or Loote as an editorial similarity, but that relationship is not a verified collaboration. Because this is a research starter rather than a completed publication profile, some background details and firsthand song explanations still require stronger evidence. In particular, a song title or a general artist biography is not sufficient proof of the specific experiences that inspired the track. Those fields are deliberately left unfilled until original interviews or artist commentary can be located.
